# Upstream license metadata

Upstream: <https://github.com/motorbridge/motorbridge-smart-servo>

Source release: `motorbridge-smart-servo` 0.0.4, commit
`319649f0b89d0aa247d8862ca4c4c72c198e6d90`.

The original PyPI source archive declares:

```text
Name: motorbridge-smart-servo
Version: 0.0.4
Author: tianrking
License-Expression: MIT
```

Its `Cargo.toml` also declares `authors = ["tianrking"]` and `license = "MIT"`.
These declarations are retained in this private source copy. The MIT license
text is available at <https://spdx.org/licenses/MIT.html>.

The original 0.0.4 source archive and the Git tree at the commit above contain
no standalone LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE file and provide no copyright year
or copyright-holder notice. This file records the supplied metadata; it does
not invent or replace an upstream copyright notice.

Local modifications preserve the rsfix1 changes and add the opcode-0x09
`set_damping` API. See [../README.md](../README.md) for provenance and build
details.
